text:
Emma (CS): FYI - BlitzPay (account blitz-prod) opened a Sev2. Between 14:12-14:35 UTC they saw ~28% 429s from our Dedicated pool in us-east-1. They say their service stayed at min_replicas=2 the whole time. Attaching their short repro and customer logs. :frowning:

Raj (Support): Thanks Emma. Do we know if account has any billing holds or quota locks? quick check on account state?

Emma (CS): No billing flag in their UI screenshot, but customer mentioned a recent invoice dispute earlier today. They said they still could create tokens.

Jordan (Eng): Can we get autoscaler decision logs for that time window? I want to know why scale-up was suppressed. Also need probe/attach latencies and any imagepull backoffs.

Maria (SRE): Pulling metrics now. Initial glance: Node-level pod readiness probes spiked to 5s+, kubelet backpressure noted on two worker nodes at 14:10-14:22. Autoscaler log snippet shows repeated "no candidates: min_replicas reached" even while queue depth increased.

Emma (CS): Customer provided a simple repro: they ran a sustained 120 qps load with 40 concurrency for 15m starting 14:12 UTC. Curl example they gave:```bash
for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"x"}' & done
```

Raj (Support): Can you paste the exact autoscaler line? Maria - that "no candidates" string, can you copy full line?

Maria (SRE): Copied from autoscaler at 14:13:02:
```
[14:13:02] autoscaler: evaluate pool=dedicated-east-1, min=2,max=50, pending=48, ready=2, eligible=0, reason="min_reached_and_probe_unready"
[14:13:02] probe: attach_latency_ms=6200, imagepull_backoff_count=3
```
So autoscaler saw pending but marked eligible=0 because we had probes unready (health gating).

Jordan (Eng): That matches a known failure mode: if attach probes are slow (imagepull or init containers), autoscaler can avoid spinning more replicas to avoid thrashing. But 6.2s attach latency seems high. Need to check if noisy neighbor caused disk/network saturation. Any noisy-tenant alarms?

ops-bot: Alert: host-02-us-east network transmit drop rate spiked 14:09-14:20 (>80% util). Affected pods: pool-dedicated-42*.

Maria (SRE): Confirmed: host-02 and host-03 showed NIC saturation due to a single tenant running large embeddings batch jobs. That caused kubelet slow-start and probe latencies to climb. Autoscaler saw the health gating and did not add more replicas because initial attach would likely fail.

Emma (CS): Customer upset — they want timeline and workaround. They use Dedicated for predictability. Any immediate mitigation we can offer?

Jordan (Eng): Short-term: increase min_replicas for the customer's pool to 4 to give more headroom, or enable burst-reserve for X minutes. Also throttle noisy tenant on affected hosts or cordon the nodes. Long-term: adjust autoscaler heuristics to consider queue depth vs probe unready, and a fallback that allows limited scale while marking attachments as "probing".

Raj (Support): Emma - propose we offer BlitzPay a 2-hour priority mitigation (raise min_replicas + temporary burst credits) while we investigate. Need customer approval.

Emma (CS): I'll message the customer with those options. They agreed to temporary increase to min_replicas=4.

Maria (SRE): Follow-ups for eng-platform: capture knob metrics - currently autoscaler flag `health_gate_threshold_ms` default 5000ms. We hit 6200ms. Suggest lowering gate during high queue depth or use queued-weighted override.

Jordan (Eng): I'll open an internal ticket with logs and suggested change: "autoscaler: allow emergency-scale when (queue_depth > N) AND (pending_count > M) despite probe_unready". Assign to eng-platform.

Raj (Support): Also check billing/account automation: invoice dispute shouldn't flip any API throttles, but confirm no org-level rate-limiter triggered.

Maria (SRE): Confirmed no billing throttles in infra logs. This was purely resource/noisy-neighbor induced.

Emma (CS): Customer updated: with min_replicas=4 they saw 429s drop to <1% and latency normalized. They're happy for now but want root cause report.

Jordan (Eng): Action items: 1) eng-platform ticket with logs + patch proposal (Jordan). 2) SRE to investigate noisy tenant and node remediation (Maria). 3) CS to prepare RCA and customer-facing timeline (Emma).

Emma (CS): Will craft the customer RCA and send by EOD. Thanks all. :pray:
